text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Will Speed Symboli have her revenge? 
Shouldering the lifelong wish of the 
Symboli household, Sirius Symboli――"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Hah. Get as hyped as you want. Just 
know, I run for nobody's sake but my own.

On the night just before the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe. Upon returning to our 
lodgings, almost as if right on cue—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Mm. What's up, what's—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Juniors
text_block_list.text:
"Sirius-san, give it your all at the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe!!"

I received a phone call from the 
underclassmen who adore Sirius Symboli.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
"Now that the moment's finally here, my 
heart's pounding so hard it's crazy!!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior B
text_block_list.text:
"Good luck! We'll all be watching the 
broadcast! And sending you cheering 
energy!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, quite the dedication. Isn't it 
the middle of the night over there, 
though?

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
"Heheh, we just HAD to call you! This guy 
was especially noisy about it... right?!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Shy Junior
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm so sorry! I thought I might be 
bothering you, but I just couldn't sit by 
and do nothing!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Shy Junior
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'll be watching closely...! Watching 
you shine out there, Senpai...! Leading 
the charge and blazing a trail...!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ………… ...A path, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
âNot my problem. And I'm certainly 
taking no responsibility. I run the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe for myself.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...However, you're free to dream as much 
as you like.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Look forward to it as much as you like.

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Shy Junior
text_block_list.text: "Y-Yes!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Junior A
text_block_list.text:
""............ Sirius, you're just so dang 
cool!!""

"—After getting all hyped up, we were 
scolded by the dorm staff who woke up from 
the noise, bringing a frantic end to our 
call."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: What a noisy bunch, as usual.

"She certainly said, 'I only run for 
myself.' —Yet perhaps there might be an 
exception."
choice_data_list:
I want to win the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.

I'd love to win the Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Hah, I'm nowhere near as soft as you 
think I am.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Forging your own future and choosing it 
for yourself ain't something you should 
leave to someone else."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"It's meaningless unless you think and 
move forward on your own. ...However—"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Say that place was shrouded in 
darkness, where you couldn't even see your 
own feet.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If it's just moving forward while looking 
up at the stars, I suppose I could forgive 
that.

I couldn't care less about the Symboli 
family's long-cherished dream. ...And yet, 
there seemed to be someone I simply 
couldn't turn a blind eye to.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—Tomorrow is going to be a busy one. I'll 
be worn out, sure, but you'll be spending 
plenty of mental energy too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't even think about staying up late 
tonight. Get to bed early, puppy.
